title: Federal court orders BitConnect restitution distribution
description: A U.S. federal court ordered $17,646,801 in restitution to be distributed to approximately 800 identified BitConnect victims in more than 40 countries through the Glenn Arcaro criminal case.
notes: This is an enforcement-linked victim recovery milestone, not a normal BitConnect repayment program and not evidence that all BitConnect victims recovered or that a platform-wide recovery percentage can be calculated.
